newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds-Spot prices steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds-Spot prices steady to lower.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices remained mostly steady to lower on Tuesday as dealers continued to monitor declining CBOT corn prices.

Carolina spot values dropped $2.00 to offer at $105.00 a ton. "Midds are higher than corn. What is moving is already on contract and you can not make a new contract because the price is too high," a Carolinas dealer said.
There was no interest. "Everyone says, 'I have enough'," a Buffalo dealer said.
Buffalo spot prices fell $5 to bid at $93.00 a ton and $3 to offer at $97.00.
One Texas dealer said the only action he saw was for this week and next week. "No one is interested in the deferreds," he said.
More alternatives were available and that put pressure on the market, another broker said.
